entries.rationale: Names the resource and the operation. `virtuals.list` said neither what it lists nor that it screens: it takes chain, status, sortBy, limit, page and pageSize and returns a filtered, ranked, bounded window of agent tokens (manifests/agents.ts:33-55), which is exactly the canonical `discover` verb rather than `list`.
Names the resource; singular for the by-id read, matching the plural discover above.

Adds the missing canonical verb. Mapped 1:1 here, but see the merge proposal in protocol-naming-2.md: the handler is virtuals.list with sort lpCreatedAt plus an AVAILABLE-and-lpCreatedAt predicate over the same projector (handlers.ts:139-178 vs :81-120).

Provider jargon expanded. `geneses` is an unusual plural that carries no meaning for a model scanning the namespace; the tool browses the genesis launch calendar, points-sale events preceding agent-token launches (manifests/agents.ts:93). Kept in the singular-noun-plus-plural-resource form with the canonical verb last.

Names the resource and adds the canonical verb. The tool reads ONE agent's bonding-curve trade tape from the provider's vp-api feed, so the resource is the agent's trades and the operation is a bounded list (manifests/market.ts).

Same shape as the trades read: one agent's OHLCV history, listed with a bound and a backwards cursor. `candles` is the term every other price-history tool in the tree uses (pools ohlcv, dexscreener bars), so the noun stays consistent across namespaces.

Existing snake words preserved, canonical by-id verb appended. The read answers for ONE agent on ONE chain from AgentTaxV2 at a pinned block (manifests/creator-fees.ts); it stays a `get` and never a claim verb, because the collection path is gated on SWAP_ROLE that the creator wallet does not hold, which the tool reports as `unsupported` with the measurement.

Names the resource and the operation, by FAMILY rather than by chain or side. One curve surface serves base and robinhood and both directions, so `agent_trade` is the resource and `quote` the canonical read verb - the same pairing every other venue uses for the priced half of a two-step trade.

The signing half of the same pair, under the canonical `execute` verb. Deliberately NOT split into buy/sell tools: the side is a parameter the prequote identity binds, and two tools would double the surface while making a buy quote look able to authorize a sell execute.
